items.description: Python arbitrary-precision integers map only inside the declared signed-int64 domain; checked arithmetic helpers remain deferred.
General Python exception and arithmetic failure equivalence remains outside the Phase 9 subset.
Calls requiring eager temporaries in Boolean or later chained-comparison operands reject pending a conditional-temporary rule.
Direct and mutual recursion are detected and rejected in Phase 9.
Only immutable UTF-8 literals and borrowed const-char-pointer calls are selected; allocation and cleanup helpers are deferred.
